title: Towards Multiscale Molecular Representation Learning through Geometry-Based Fragmentation for Polymer Property Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.07998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: It is well established that molecular substructures can contribute unequally to chemical and physical properties, with specific motifs or side chains often playing dominant roles. Fragment-based representations have therefore emerged as an effective strategy for incorporating chemically meaningful inductive biases, as exemplified by molecular fingerprints and fragment-based attention mechanisms. However, many existing fragmentation-based machine learning methods rely on predefined chemical rules, which may yield suboptimal fragmentation for previously unseen or chemically unfamiliar structures and often overlook the importance of multiscale molecular representations. translated_title: 面向聚合物性质预测的基于几何片段化的多尺度分子表示学习
translated_abstract: 众所周知，分子亚结构对化学和物理性质的贡献是不均等的，特定的基序或侧链往往起着主导作用。因此，基于片段的表示已成为引入具有化学意义的归纳偏置的有效策略，分子指纹和基于片段的注意力机制便是典型例子。然而，许多现有的基于片段化的机器学习方法依赖于预定义的化学规则，这对于之前未见过的或化学上陌生的结构可能产生次优的片段化结果，并且往往忽视了多尺度分子表示的重要性。为解决这些局限性，我们将分子片段化表述为一个受k-center公式启发的、以半径为约束的优化问题，其中簇的数量并非先验固定，而是由指定的半径决定，并提出了一种基于几何的片段化方法。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种受k-center启发的、基于几何的半径约束分子片段化方法，实现多尺度分子表示学习，从而提升聚合物性质预测的性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a geometry-based, radius-constrained molecular fragmentation method inspired by the k-center formulation to enable multiscale molecular representation learning for improved polymer property prediction.
